events.verdict: George (UTA) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.
Cunningham (DET) is already in Sensabaugh's (UTA) path when contact occurs, and he absorbs the contact during the screen.

events.category: Turnover: Out of Bounds – Bad Pass Turn
events.verdict: LeVert (DET) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.
Harris (DET) and Nurkic (UTA) engage and disengage with one another and marginal contact occurs off-ball in the post.
Harris (DET) brings his arms forward and removes them from Nurkic's (UTA) body during his upward shooting motion on the post-shot attempt.
Nurkic (UTA) establishes screening position outside of Green's (DET) field of view and marginal contact occurs as the screen is set.
LeVert (DET) makes clean contact with the ball to block George's (UTA) driving shot attempt.
Duren (DET) briefly grasps Nurkic's (UTA) jersey and releases it as both players engage and separate during the rebound.
Cunningham (DET) makes clean contact with the ball and dislodges it away from Sensabaugh (UTA) prior to any incidental contact occurring.
Nurkic (UTA) jumps into Cunningham (DET) and initiates illegal body contact, which affects his driving shot attempt before the block.
Green (DET) retracts his extended arm when marginal contact occurs with George's (UTA) off-arm after his gather.
Collier (UTA) maintains a legal guarding position alongside Cunningham's (DET) path during his dribble. The incidental contact occurs before Cunningham's upward shooting motion.
Collier (UTA) legally contests Cunningham's (DET) jump shot attempt.
